integrity: The previously published seven-vertex optimum and count of 960 are used as a baseline, not attributed as new. The new orbit exhaustion follows from explicit distinguishing distance profiles, exact stabilizer computations, and a sum of three disjoint orbit sizes equaling the known full census. A standalone exact verifier independently reconstructs all 960 minima and the group action.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification solely for radius-one single-vertex identifying codes on the 16 vertices of the binary four-cube, modulo its full automorphism group. The known optimal size and labeled census are not novel. No classification for other dimensions, radii, or multiple faults is asserted.
title: Three symmetry types of minimum identifying codes in the four-dimensional binary cube
